subject.title: fix(acp): ACP session startup fails when backend does not advertise thinking config

question: Should ACP sessions continue inheriting configured or model-profile thinking when the spawn call has no explicit thinking override?
rationale: Current code, tests, and acpx launch behavior establish inheritance, while this PR intentionally changes ACP to explicit-thinking-only to accommodate limited backends.

options.title: Preserve inheritance
options.body: Keep configured and model-profile thinking, consume it through backend-owned launch configuration, and suppress only the redundant unsupported manager control.

options.title: Adopt explicit-only ACP
options.body: Remove inheritance only with explicit owner approval, updated contract tests and docs, and fresh-install plus upgrade proof.

recommendation.title: Preserve inheritance
recommendation.body: Keep configured and model-profile thinking, consume it through backend-owned launch configuration, and suppress only the redundant unsupported manager control.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the current ACP spawn and acpx thinking-routing contract and is the strongest history-backed decision owner.
